case_number: 2025 INSC 106; CRIMINAL APPEAL NO. OF 2025 (@ SLP Criminal No. 9885 of 2023)

parties.respondent: The State rep. by the Inspector of Police

summary: Conviction under IPC s.498A and DP Act s.4 upheld based on dowry demand and harassment; sentence modified due to prolonged litigation, appellant's IT expertise, and societal reconciliation; reliance on Samaul Sk. vs. State of Jharkhand for reducing sentence to period undergone; community service and compensation considered; concurrent sentences adjusted.
legal_provisions_cited: Samaul Sk. vs. The State of Jharkhand & Anr. (2021 INSC 429)
final_judgment: Conviction under Section 498A IPC and Section 4 DP Act upheld; sentence reduced to the period already undergone; appeal partly allowed.
